title: 第17章 她被关祠堂
lines: 像是有人拿着钝刀，一寸一寸在骨头里搅。
冷汗瞬间从额头滑落，喉咙里一阵腥甜，她几乎是本能地侧身，避开了那种要命的窒息感。
眼前不是医院白光，也不是实验室的无菌环境。
而是一间破旧潮湿的屋子。
霉味、灰尘、冷风，从四面八方灌进来。
窗纸破了一个大洞，风一吹，发出“哗啦哗啦”的响声。
无数不属于她的记忆，像刀一样刺入神经——
“连下人都可以踩一脚的存在。”
最后一幕，是一碗黑色的药，被强行灌入喉中。
手腕细白，却有一道极细的黑色针孔。
这毒不致命，但会一点点封死经脉，让人“自然废掉”，再被世界遗弃。
一个穿着华丽衣裙的少女站在门口，身后跟着两名丫鬟。
脸上是毫不掩饰的厌恶。
content_zh:
宫宴的混乱还没散尽。

    但真正的风暴，才刚刚开始。

    迟息散的事，被强行压了下去。

    表面上，是内侍误饮。

    但所有人都知道——

    那杯茶，本该落在苏晚身上。

    而她，躲过去了。

    不仅躲过去了。

    还“借势救人”。

    让苏柔的局，变成了一场当众失控的反噬。

    苏柔被禁足。

    但禁足的第三日，她就见到了一个人。

    ——继母。

    屋内灯光很暗。

    继母坐在阴影里。

    苏柔站在门口，脸色苍白。

    “娘……我不是故意的。”

    她声音发抖。

    继母没有看她。

    只是慢慢开口：

    “你动了最不该动的东西。”

    苏柔一愣。

    “什么？”

    继母抬眼。

    “她的‘反应路径’。”

    苏柔听不懂。

    继母却已经不想解释。

    她站起身。

    走到窗前。

    “苏晚现在已经不是‘防守型的人’了。”

    “她在引导局。”

    苏柔咬牙：

    “那我们就再做一次！”

    “我不信她每次都能赢！”

    继母看着她。

    眼神第一次有了冷意。

    “你还没看清楚吗？”

    苏柔一愣。

    继母缓缓说：

    “你每一次出手。”

    “都在给她提供数据。”

    空气一瞬间冷了下来。

    苏柔手指发抖。

    “那我什么都不能做吗？！”

    继母没有回答。

    只是低声说了一句：

    “你已经被她标记了。”

    苏柔脸色彻底白了。

    “标记？”

    继母点头。

    “她现在看你。”

    “不是在看一个对手。”

    她顿了一下。

    “是在看一个‘样本’。”

    与此同时。

    苏晚在宫中偏殿。

    她正在给一名宫女换药。

    那宫女手上有烫伤。

    很轻。

    但苏晚处理得极细致。

    像在修复一件器物。

    宫女忍不住低声问：

    “苏姑娘……那日的事……真的是误会吗？”

    苏晚没有抬头。

    “不是误会。”

    宫女一愣：

    “那是……”

    苏晚轻声：

    “是试探。”

    她说得很平静。

    平静得像在讲天气。

    宫女低声：

    “谁在试您？”

    苏晚停了一瞬。

    然后说：

    “很多人。”

    她换完药，起身。

    走到窗边。

    看着宫墙外的天。

    “他们现在开始变聪明了。”

    她轻声说。

    “但还不够。”

    夜里。

    相府暗线传来消息。

    “苏柔欲见外人。”

    “疑似再布新局。”

    继母听完，没有立刻说话。

    只是轻轻放下茶盏。

    “让她做。”

    下人一愣：

    “夫人？”
content_en:
The chaos of the palace banquet has not yet cleared up.

    But the real storm has just begun.

    The matter of Chi Xisan was forcibly suppressed.

    On the surface, the waiter drank it by mistake.

    But everyone knows——

    That cup of tea should have fallen on Su Wan.

    And she hid.

    Not only escaped.

    He also "takes advantage of the situation to save people."

    Su Rou's situation turned into a public out-of-control backlash.

    Su Rou was grounded.

    But on the third day of the lockdown, she saw someone.

    ——Stepmother.

    The lights inside the house are dim.

    The stepmother sat in the shadows.

    Su Rou stood at the door, her face pale.

    "Mom...I didn't mean it."

    Her voice trembled.

    The stepmother didn't look at her.

    Just speak slowly:

    "You touched something you shouldn't have touched."

    Su Rou was stunned.

    "What?"

    Stepmother raised her eyes.

    “Her ‘reaction path’.”

    Su Rou couldn't understand.

    But the stepmother no longer wanted to explain.

    She stood up.

    Go to the window.

    "Su Wan is no longer a 'defensive person'."

    "She's in the guidance bureau."

    Su Rou gritted her teeth:

    "Then let's do it again!"

    "I don't believe she can win every time!"

    The stepmother looked at her.

    For the first time, his eyes were cold.

    "Haven't you seen clearly yet?"

    Su Rou was stunned.

    The stepmother said slowly:

    "Every time you take action."

    "They are all providing her with data."

    The air suddenly became colder.

    Su Rou's fingers trembled.

    "Then there's nothing I can do?!"

    The stepmother didn't answer.

    Just whispered:

    "You've been marked by her."

    Su Rou's face turned completely pale.

    "Mark?"

    Stepmother nodded.

    "She's looking at you now."

    "Not looking at an opponent."

    She paused.

    "I'm looking at a 'sample'."

    At the same time.

    Su Wan was in the side hall of the palace.

    She was changing the dressing of a palace maid.

    The palace maid had burns on her hands.

    Very light.

    But Su Wan handled it very carefully.

    It's like repairing an object.

    The palace maid couldn't help but asked in a low voice:

    "Miss Su... was what happened that day... really a misunderstanding?"

    Su Wan didn't look up.

    "It's not a misunderstanding."

    The palace maid was stunned:

    "That's..."

    Su Wan whispered:

    "It's a test."

    She spoke calmly.

    As calm as talking about the weather.

    The palace maid whispered:

    "Who's testing you?"

    Su Wan paused for a moment.

    Then say:

    "A lot of people."

    After changing the medicine, she got up.

    Go to the window.

    Looking at the sky outside the palace wall.

    "They're starting to get smarter now."

    she said softly.

    "But it's not enough."

    at night.

    News came from the Prime Minister's house secretly.

    "Su Rou wants to meet outsiders."

    "It seems like a new plot is being laid."

    After hearing this, the stepmother did not speak immediately.

    Just put down the tea cup gently.

    "Let her do it."

    The servant was stunned:

    "Ma'am?"
title_en: Chapter 17 She was imprisoned in the ancestral hall
